name: pr-watch
description: A Claude Code mod that watches the pull requests a session opens and the CI on their heads, on GitHub and Forgejo. A successful `gh pr create` or `fj pr create` adds the PR to a pane; a 20-second timer then asks the forge's own CLI for state and checks (`gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup` on GitHub; `fj pr view` plus `fj actions tasks` matched to the head commit on Forgejo), so each CLI's existing login is the only credential involved. A toast fires when CI passes or fails and when a PR is merged or closed. `/prs` opens the pane, `/prs add <url>` watches an existing PR, `/prs refresh` polls now, and `/prs clear` drops merged and closed ones.
